text:
ITEM 1 | Chopped leafy greens (pale to medium green, crisp-looking pieces with pale white-green ribs, torn into irregular pieces about 3-6 cm long) with a creamy, pale off-white coating clinging to the leaves, spread across the left and center of a white square plate covering roughly 40% of its surface, mounded about 2-3 cm high | 150
ITEM 2 | Cubes of golden-tan toasted bread (about 1.5-2 cm squares) with browned, slightly crisp edges and dry, matte surface, scattered among the greens, roughly 4-5 pieces visible | 15
ITEM 3 | Creamy pale ivory dressing coating the leaves, glossy and slightly thick, pooled in small patches between leaves and not forming a separate pool on the plate | 20
ITEM 4 | Small shaved or grated pale yellow-white cheese flakes (under 1 cm), dry and matte, sprinkled over the leaves near the center | 5
